summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 new pages under Sample Blocks (Empty States, Permissions, Data Display) plus a light DataTable regression. All acceptance criteria from the review request pass; no console/runtime errors detected.
tests_executed: EmptyStatesBlockPage: all 6 cards render (es-card-no-data, es-card-no-results, es-card-first-time, es-card-forbidden, es-card-offline, es-card-error); icons + titles + descriptions present; action buttons present with correct labels (Add item / Clear filters / Create your first item / Retry / Try again); forbidden card has no action button.

PermissionsBlockPage: default role Admin. Verified all 4 cards across Admin -> Viewer -> Member -> Admin transitions: perm-hide-action visible only for Admin (removed from DOM otherwise); perm-disable-action enabled only for Admin, disabled for Member/Viewer (wrapped in span[tabindex=0] for tooltip); perm-readonly-input editable for Admin/Member, readOnly for Viewer; perm-forbidden-content shown for Admin/Member, perm-forbidden-empty shown for Viewer.

DataDisplayBlockPage: dd-table renders 3 rows; Amount/Growth/Units columns are text-right; Row 2 negative amount (-320) and growth (-0.045) render with text-destructive class; Row 3 nil fields (amount, growth, units, created, active) render as em dash '—'; Status badges render exactly Active/Inactive/Pending.
Sidebar: 'Sample Blocks' group lists Empty States, Permissions, Data Display; links navigate correctly; breadcrumb 'Design System > Sample Blocks > <Page>' updates on each page.
Regression: /design-system/layouts/datatable filter typed 'zzzzznotfoundxxx' -> dt-empty-filtered and dt-clear-filters both render (count=1).
critical_code_review_comments: EmptyState composite is clean, uses shadcn Empty primitive and lucide icons; testid override supported. No issues.
PermissionsBlockPage correctly wraps the disabled Button in a span[tabindex=0] so the Tooltip can still trigger for non-admins (matches note in review request).
DataDisplayBlockPage uses tabular-nums + text-right on numeric columns and delegates nil handling to lib/format helpers — good separation of concerns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new pages (empty-states, permissions, data-display) verified end-to-end with data-testid selectors. Permissions covered all 3 roles. DataTable filter empty-state regression still works. If iterating further, target Sample Charts pages (not touched this iteration).
